description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Astrolab develops software tools used to build, test, and operate its lunar rovers. The Full Stack Developer will create and maintain software for mission operations, engineering, testing, and internal workflows, including back-end systems, user interfaces, and automated deployment and testing pipelines.
Full Stack Developer (All Levels) supporting the in-house software lifecycle, building backend workflows, web/desktop interfaces, and automated delivery pipelines

Responsibilities:
• Develop software for a wide variety of applications, including mission operations software, specialized tools to support engineering tasks, internal monitoring tooling, and more
• Coordinate with stakeholders to define software needs and produce robust design criteria and use cases
• Integrate and test software applications to ensure reliability, functionality, and performance
• Develop robust, high performance back end tooling to handle complicated workflows and large amounts of data
• Develop intuitive, easy to use  web-based and desktop application front end user interfaces that meet the specific needs of users
• Develop automated pipelines for regression testing, pre-deployment verification and validation, deployment, and patching
• Ensure all software produced meets applicable security standards and data protection needs
• Support the overall planning, design, development, deployment, maintenance, and integration of Astrolab’s in house software tools

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree in a science, technology, engineering, mathematics (STEM) related field
• 1+ years of experience with Python, javascript, typescript, and other languages commonly used for software applications
• Experience with automated testing, CI/CD systems, infrastructure as code paradigms, and similar modern software development tooling and practices

Preferred:
• Experience developing software for the following applications or similar:
• Human-rated safety critical software applications
• Mission control or vehicle control software with web-based user interfaces
• Engineering tools to support manufacturing workflows, avionics testing, or vehicle integration and testing
• Software for safety critical medical applications
• Database backends for efficient handling of large amounts of data and associated relationships with web-based user front ends for searching, organizing, and displaying engineering information
• Experience implementing software that meets NIST 800-171 and NIST 800-53 security specifications
• Experience with static analysis tooling, dynamic memory analysis tooling, fuzz testing, penetration testing, and other methods used to detect potential security defects
• Experience with NASA or DoD software safety standards and software certification processes
